draft: From inside, we describe our worship as prayer, converse with God, spoken or silent [[alx.term.prayer]] [[as:paraphrase]]. Our teaching for baptism was katechesis, given step by step over a long time [[alx.term.katechesis]] [[as:paraphrase]]. Our own record keeps its failures visible: our greatest teacher was driven out by his own bishop, not by pagans [[alx.dw.church-failure]] [[as:paraphrase]]. Dionysius wrote of Alexandrian Christians nursing plague victims fearlessly, many dying of it, while the plague was still raging [[alx.story.plague-nursing]] [[as:paraphrase]]. The school side of our record is well attested, and the community side is thinly attested [[alx.gravity.learning-community-tension]] [[as:paraphrase]].
final: Our teaching for baptism was katechesis, given step by step over a long time. Our own record keeps its failures visible: our greatest teacher was driven out by his own bishop, not by pagans. The school side of our record is well attested, and the community side is thinly attested.
question: Given that a key outside record of your worship was obtained under torture, how reliable is that source?
